metadata.title: DocuMind — your AI document knowledge base
metadata.description: Upload documents, confirm the data extracted by vision AI, and query them by semantic search and chat.

notFound.title: Page not found

search.title: QUERY THE ARCHIVE
search.placeholder: What are you looking for? e.g.: the electrical installation invoice

upload.tagline: Upload a document: the vision LLM reads it, you review and confirm its fields, and it joins your knowledge base — searchable by search and chat.
upload.browse: or click to browse your files
upload.caption: The sheet fills itself: the vision LLM reads the attachment and completes the fields with your real data. You review, stamp and archive.
upload.unsupported: Unsupported format. Use JPG, PNG, WEBP or PDF.
